display.summary: A Composer-driven update now delivers the release's static files, instead of leaving the previous release's CSS and JS in place against the new templates.
highlights: Updates stop looking half-applied: unstyled controls and dead scripts after an update were the previous release's assets still being served.
Collection runs after an apply, a rollback, or an apply Composer rolled back — all three change which release is active.
A collect that fails is named in the run log and recorded on the run, rather than leaving a mismatch to be found by looking at the page.
